front: Khái niệm 'Mixed Conditionals (Type 3 + Type 2 & Type 2 + Type 3)' trong Unit 10: Lifelong Learning được định nghĩa như thế nào?
back:
Conditionals where the time of the if-clause is different from the time of the main clause. Common mix: Past condition (Type 3: If + had V3) with Present result (Type 2: would + V-base).

💡 Ví dụ: If I had practiced English regularly during high school, I would be completely confident in international communication today.
🌱 Bản chất: Connecting past decisions with enduring present reality and identity.

front: Khái niệm 'Lifelong Learning' trong Unit 10: Lifelong Learning được định nghĩa như thế nào?
back:
The ongoing, voluntary, and self-motivated pursuit of knowledge for either personal or professional reasons throughout life.

💡 Ví dụ: Professionals enrolling in evening coding bootcamps to transition into data science.
🌱 Bản chất: Essential survival mindset in an era of rapid technological disruption.

front: Phát biểu quy tắc / định lí: 'Mixed Conditional Type 3 condition with Type 2 result'?
back:
If + S + had (not) + V3/ed [past action], S + would/could (not) + V-base [present state/consequence].

📝 Ví dụ: If she had accepted that scholarship last year, she would be studying in Canada now.
🔑 Ý nghĩa: Counterfactual past causing counterfactual present.

front: Phương pháp giải bài toán: 'Combine using a mixed conditional: 'He didn't learn computer programming in college. Now he is unable to apply for this software engineer position.''?
back:
Các bước giải chi tiết:
Step 1: Past condition: He didn't learn -> If he had learned computer programming in college.
Step 2: Present consequence: He cannot apply -> he would be able to apply for this software engineer position now.
Step 3: Combine: If he had learned computer programming in college, he would be able to apply for this software engineer position now.

👉 Kết luận: If he had learned computer programming in college, he would be able to apply for this software engineer position now.

front: Bẫy sai lầm cần tránh: Using 'would have V3' in both clauses: *If he would have studied, he would have...*?
back:
❌ Lỗi sai: Using 'would have V3' in both clauses: *If he would have studied, he would have...*

💡 Nguyên nhân & Khắc phục: The if-clause never contains 'would'; use Past Perfect (had studied) in the if-clause.
